name: Standard Export PO Terms
terms:
1. Payment Terms: Payment shall be made as per agreed milestones mentioned in the Purchase Order against submission of commercial invoice, packing list, and bill of lading.
  2. Inspection & Quality: Material subject to pre-shipment inspection by Authorized Inspector / Third Party (SGS / Intertek / Bureau Veritas). Seller must provide inspection test certificates prior to dispatch.
  3. Liquidated Damages (LD): In case of delayed delivery beyond the agreed schedule, Liquidated Damages shall be levied @ 0.5% of total PO value per week of delay, subject to a maximum cap of 10%.
  4. Warranty: Equipment carries a comprehensive warranty of 12 months from commissioning or 18 months from shipment date, whichever is earlier. Defective parts shall be replaced free of cost.
  5. Packaging & ISPM-15 Compliance: All wooden packaging, pallets, and crates must be heat treated and stamped in full compliance with ISPM-15 international phytosanitary standards.
  6. Force Majeure: Neither party shall be liable for failure to perform obligations due to acts of God, war, civil commotion, pandemic restrictions, or severe maritime shipping blockades.
  7. Governing Law & Jurisdiction: This contract shall be governed by Indian Laws, and any disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of courts in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.
title: Standard Export PO Terms

name: Export to Africa Terms
terms:
1. Export Packaging: Material must be packed in sea-worthy, heavy-duty export containers / flat racks with anti-corrosive coating and moisture absorbers.
  2. Pre-Shipment Inspection (PSI): Mandatory Pre-Shipment Inspection (SGS/Bureau Veritas) required for African import clearance. Inspection certificate must accompany shipping documents.
  3. Port Clearance & Demurrage: Delivery terms Ex-Works / FOB as agreed. All destination port demurrage and customs duties in Africa are on buyer's account unless otherwise specified.
  4. Documentation: Seller must provide original Commercial Invoice, Bill of Lading (BL), Certificate of Origin, Packing List, and Phytosanitary Certificate within 7 days of shipment departure.
title: Export to Africa Terms

name: Domestic India Terms
terms:
1. GST & Invoicing: Valid Tax Invoice clearly stating HSN/SAC codes, CGST/SGST/IGST breakdown, and supplier GSTIN is mandatory for payment processing.
  2. E-Way Bill: Supplier must generate valid E-Way Bill for transport vehicles prior to dispatch of goods.
  3. Delivery & Freight: Delivery at specified site yard. Freight extra at actuals or inclusive as stated in PO. Transit insurance cover required.
  4. Warranty & Service: Standard 1-year manufacturer warranty against manufacturing defects. On-site service support to be provided within 48 hours of call logging.
title: Domestic India Terms

name: LUT Certificate Terms
terms:
1. Zero-Rated Export under LUT: Supplies made under Letter of Undertaking (LUT) without payment of integrated tax as per Section 16 of IGST Act, 2017 / Rule 96A of CGST Rules.
  2. Concessional GST Rate (0.1%): Applicable concessional GST @ 0.1% for merchant exports / LUT exports. Seller must provide LUT ARN acknowledgement copy.
  3. Proof of Export: Buyer / Merchant Exporter shall provide Shipping Bill copy / Export invoice proof within 90 days of invoice date.
title: LUT Certificate Terms

name: Guinea BSTP SAS Procurement Terms
terms:
1. Entity & Port Compliance: Purchase Order issued for Sarveksha BSTP SAS (Conakry, Guinea). All shipments to Port of Conakry must meet Guinean customs import requirements.
  2. Container & Freight Specs: Freight and sea transport on CIF/FOB terms as agreed. Wooden packaging must have anti-fungal treatment and ISPM-15 stamping.
  3. Inspection & Customs: Goods subject to pre-loading inspection. Commercial invoice, BL, and Packing List must explicitly state Sarveksha BSTP SAS as consignee.
  4. Warranty & Spare Parts: Supplier shall ensure supply of essential maintenance spare parts for a minimum operational period of 2 years.
title: Guinea BSTP SAS Procurement Terms

name: Cameroon Mining & Minerals Terms
terms:
1. Cameroon Port & Customs: Purchase Order for Sarveksha Mining SARL / Baani Minerals. Goods routed through Port of Douala, Cameroon.
  2. Pre-Shipment Verification: Mandatory SGS / Bureau Veritas inspection report required prior to vessel departure from port of origin.
  3. Heavy Equipment Transport: Heavy machinery and crusher units must be secured using certified heavy-lashing and export-grade tarping for ocean transit.
  4. Technical Documentation: Operation manuals, parts catalogs, and electrical schematics in English & French must accompany equipment delivery.
title: Cameroon Mining & Minerals Terms

name: Sierra Leone Procurement Terms
terms:
1. Sierra Leone Import Norms: Issued for Sarveksha SL Limited (Freetown, Sierra Leone). Shipments cleared through Queen Elizabeth II Quay (Freetown Port).
  2. Phytosanitary & Country of Origin: Certificate of Origin and Phytosanitary Certificate are compulsory for customs declaration in Sierra Leone.
  3. Insurance & Lashing: Full marine cargo insurance required covering transit from origin manufacturer plant to Freetown mine site.
  4. Payment Clearance: Final payment released upon receipt of clean On-Board Bill of Lading and satisfactory physical verification on site.
title: Sierra Leone Procurement Terms

name: Botswana Mining & Equipment Terms
terms:
1. Transit via Port of Durban: Issued for Sarveksha Botswana Proprietary Limited. Inland sea-land transit via Port of Durban / Gaborone bonded warehouse.
  2. SADC & SACU Regulations: Compliance with SADC customs trade agreements, certificate of origin, and road transport axle load regulations.
  3. Commissioning Support: Supplier engineer to oversee installation and performance testing at site upon delivery.
  4. Defect Liability: 12-month defect liability period with immediate replacement of non-conforming components.
title: Botswana Mining & Equipment Terms
